chunks: A man said to him, peace be upon him: “I pray with my family, then I go out to the mosque and they put me forward.”
So he said: “Go forward; there is no harm upon you, and lead them in prayer.”

key_terms.بِهِمْ: with them, meaning as their prayer leader
key_terms.فَيُقَدِّمُونِي: they put me forward to lead

ai.seo_question: Can someone who already prayed at home lead the congregational prayer in the mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that a person who has already prayed with his family may still lead congregational salat in the mosque afterward. It indicates that doing so is permissible and carries no blame.
